payload.title: Deliver private draft-first support and explicit merchant handoff
payload.goal: Support fit questions from approved evidence without becoming seller or making unauthorized commitments.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Reuse retained customer-operations architecture and taxonomy; qualify mailbox/private encrypted store/model route separately and keep runtime messages outside the public repository.
Ingest scoped support-label events into deduplicated threaded tickets with retention/deletion; classify uncertain fit, source correction, merchant return request and sensitive/safety escalation.
Generate cited draft responses that state unknowns and next measurements; run prompt-injection, privacy and factual QA against approved source ledger.
Pilot draft-only under explicit recipient/response authority; sending is a distinct gated adapter and requires approved low-risk category, template, canary limits and destination sent/readback.

Current affiliate role never cancels, returns, replaces or refunds merchant orders; preserve BF-026..028 as conditional future seller/delegation scope and route buyer to merchant with general guidance.
tests: Repeated email event produces one private ticket/draft; secret/PII canary never reaches public/Jira logs.
Injection in email or manufacturer page cannot widen tools, access, spending or communication authority.
Return/refund demand yields general merchant handoff; no account/order action occurs.
Auto-send remains disabled until exact pilot review and authority gate; crash-after-send reconciles sent ID before retry.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Draft-only support produces useful reviewed answers and safe merchant escalation with private evidence.
Any later auto-send qualification is limited to approved categories with verified receipts; unsupported seller actions stay denied.
payload.rollback: Disable sends/intake as needed, preserve private tickets and fulfill pending approved support obligations through designated owner; never expose raw messages.
payload.next_eligible_action: Implement redacted draft-only fixtures and policy denial for seller actions; prepare one missing-mailbox input record.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Mailbox/private store/model access are unverified; offline redacted fixtures proceed without them.
